sloka: न किञ्चिन्म कर्तव्यं तवान्यत्राभिषेचनात् ।अतो युत्त्वामहं ब्रूयां तन्मे त्वं कर्तुमर्हसि ॥२-४-१५॥
transliteration: na kiñcinma kartavyaṁ tavānyatrābhiṣecanāt ।ato yuttvāmahaṁ brūyāṁ tanme tvaṁ kartumarhasi ॥2-4-15॥

translations.english: There is nothing left to be done by me except your consecration Hence you should perform what I tell you.
